name: Chat drop multiple files fails
description:
1. **Task 1 — Chat drop bug:** dropping multiple files persisted only the last one, because each file fired an un-awaited `file_list` update built from the same stale list.
2. **Fix:** added a per-chat write queue (`ChatService.addFilesToChat`) that dedupes at execution time, plus `onAddFiles()` batching a whole drop into one write in `Chat.vue`.
3. **Task 2 — File selection:** requested marquee (rectangle) drag selection, `Shift`+click range and `Ctrl`+click multi-select in both grid and list views, with `Ctrl`+click no longer opening a tab.
4. **Fix:** `FileExplorer.vue` gained a marquee overlay in content coordinates (only starting on blank space, so native dragging still works) and a reworked `handleEntryClick` (shift = range, ctrl = toggle, plain = open).
5. **Also:** `FileViewer.vue` now has an "Open in new tab" header icon using `showApp({ newInstance: true })` to open a duplicate `file-viewer` panel.

messages.content:
Allow to select multiple files using a "rectangle like" tool where user clicks and drags over a group of icons to select them.
Allow to seect multiple files with shift+click and ctrl+clikc in the tree view (icons and list mode)

The ctrl+clilck won't open the file in new tab, instead will toggle selectection adding, removing from the selection.

 FileViewer will have an icon to open file in new tab

I'll explore the file viewer and tree components to understand the current selection model.## Review & Understand **Objective** 1. **Marquee selection** — drag a rectangle over a group of icons/tiles (and rows) to select them all. 2. **Shift+click / Ctrl+click** multi-select in the file tree view (grid **and** list mode). 3. **Ctrl+click no longer opens a new tab** — it toggles the entry in/out of the selection. 4. **FileViewer gets an “open in new tab” icon.** ## Information Gathering - `src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` already renders two views (`viewMode: 'list' | 'grid'`) over the same `visibleEntries` collection and already tracks `selectedEntries` / `lastSelectedIndex`, with `addSelection`, `toggleSelection`, `selectRange`, `clearSelection`. - Current click logic (`handleEntryClick`) does: shift → range, **ctrl → `$ui.openFileInViewer(...)`** (opens tab), plain → open/enter folder. So requirement 3 is a one-branch change; 1 and 2 need the marquee plus ctrl-toggle. - Entries are `draggable="true"` (`onDragStart`/`onDragEnd` for file drag & drop and multi-item move), so the marquee must only start on **empty space**, never on a tile. - The scroll container is the outer div; anything absolutely positioned with page coordinates would skew on scroll. ⇒ the rectangle must live in a `relative` wrapper around the entries and use container-relative coordinates. - `src/components/filebrowser/FileViewer.vue` receives `params` (`{ ...app.params, app }` per `store/views.syncPanelsWithApps` / `Desktop.addPanel`). New tabs/panels are created by `$storex.ui.showApp(...)`; its de-duplication is skipped with `newInstance: true` (same mechanism as `cloneApp`), and `Desktop` then materialises the panel. ## Change Proposal | File | Change | |------|--------| | `src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` | Entries get `data-entry-path` (+ `data-no-marquee` on the `..` rows). New `relative` wrapper with `@mousedown` draws a marquee (`selectionBox`) and selects every entry it touches; Ctrl/⌘ starts an additive marquee. `handleEntryClick` ctrl branch now **toggles selection** instead of opening a tab. Listeners cleaned up on unmount. | | `src/components/filebrowser/FileViewer.vue` | Header button “Open in new tab” → `openInNewTab()` opens a fresh `file-viewer` panel for the current file via `showApp({ newInstance: true })`. |

messages.content: I'll read the actual components to complete the implementation that was cut off.Let me check `showApp` / `openFileInViewer` to implement "open in new tab" correctly.## Review & Understand **Continuing the in-progress feature** (`FileExplorer` / `FileViewer` multi-select): 1. **Marquee selection** — drag a rectangle over the empty area of the tree to select every entry it touches (grid **and** list view). 2. **Shift+click / Ctrl+click** multi-select in both views. 3. **Ctrl+click toggles the selection** instead of opening a new tab. 4. **FileViewer** gets an *Open in new tab* icon. ## Information Gathering (confirmed in code) - `FileExplorer.vue` is ` ## Anti-Patterns avoided - ❌ Starting the marquee on a tile → it would fight the native **file drag & drop** (`draggable="true"`). The gesture only starts on blank space. - ❌ Positioning the rectangle with page/client coordinates inside a scroll container → the overlay drifts away from the entries on scroll. Geometry is converted to **content** coordinates. - ❌ `preventDefault()` on the click instead of the mousedown → would break the `..` row navigation. `..` is explicitly excluded via `data-no-marquee`. - ❌ Reusing the shared `file-viewer` panel for "open in new tab" → `showApp` de-duplicates by key; `newInstance: true` is required. ## Accessibility checklist - `Ctrl`/`⌘` click **no longer navigates**: multi-select is now keyboard-modifier friendly and non-destructive. - Marquee is purely additive to existing click paths — every entry is still reachable by Tab-less mouse click, and the excluded `..` row keeps its single-click behaviour. - Marquee overlay is `pointer-events-none` (never steals clicks) and uses `border-primary`/`bg-primary/20` (visible on the dark base, >3:1 against `#1a1a1a`). - "Open in new tab" button has a `title` and a FontAwesome icon (`fa-up-right-from-square`), consistent with the header's other icon buttons. ## Implementation steps 1. Apply `FileExplorer.vue`. 2. Apply `FileViewer.vue`. 3. Verify: - Drag a rectangle over icons in **grid** mode → all touched entries highlight; `Ctrl`+drag adds to the existing selection. - Same in **list** mode; scrolling during a drag keeps the rectangle glued to the rows. - `Ctrl`+click toggles one entry (no new tab opens); `Shift`+click selects a range; plain click still opens/enters. - Right-click → contextual actions (move/delete) act on the marquee selection. - Open a file → click the new header icon → a second `file-viewer` panel appears with the same file.

history.summary:
**Summary (5 lines):**

1. **Issue:** dropping multiple files onto the chat only attached the last one — the rest silently vanished.
2. **Root cause:** each dropped file fired its own unawaited `file_list` write, all built from the same stale `chat.file_list`, so the last response overwrote the others.
3. **Service fix (`src/service/chat.js`):** new `addFilesToChat({ chat, files })` dedupes at execution time and queues writes per chat, so every update starts from the previously stored list; `addFileToChat` delegates to it.
4. **UI fix (`src/components/chat/Chat.vue`):** `onAddFiles()` batches a whole drop into a single write, awaited by `onAddFile`, `processFilePaths` and `confirmUpload`; malformed URI payloads no longer abort the drop.
5. **Result:** one intent = one write — all dropped/uploaded files persist and survive a chat reload, with no visual or accessibility changes.

1. **Task 1 — Chat drop bug:** dropping multiple files persisted only the last one, because each file fired an un-awaited `file_list` update built from the same stale list.
2. **Fix:** added a per-chat write queue (`ChatService.addFilesToChat`) that dedupes at execution time, plus `onAddFiles()` batching a whole drop into one write in `Chat.vue`.
3. **Task 2 — File selection:** requested marquee (rectangle) drag selection, `Shift`+click range and `Ctrl`+click multi-select in both grid and list views, with `Ctrl`+click no longer opening a tab.
4. **Fix:** `FileExplorer.vue` gained a marquee overlay in content coordinates (only starting on blank space, so native dragging still works) and a reworked `handleEntryClick` (shift = range, ctrl = toggle, plain = open).
5. **Also:** `FileViewer.vue` now has an "Open in new tab" header icon using `showApp({ newInstance: true })` to open a duplicate `file-viewer` panel.
